description: Boolean logic on two or three gate inputs, with all six results on their own outputs at once

inputs.text: One of the gates being compared, counted as true above 1V
A third gate for the comparisons, counted as true above 1V; with nothing patched here the outputs compare In A and In B alone

outputs.text: 10V when any input is true, 0V when none is
10V when at least one input is true but not all of them
10V when the inputs are all in the same state
